title: House of the Sun
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Seventeen-year-old Mao feels unwanted at home after her parents' divorce and her father's remarriage, so she moves in with Hiro, a 24-year-old childhood friend living alone in the house where she found refuge as a child. Hiro hopes to reunite his siblings Daiki and Hina, scattered after their parents' deaths, while Mao works to make the house a home again and to reconcile with her own family. Kodansha USA released it digitally; it won the 2014 Kodansha Manga Award for shoujo.
life_message: It holds up home, family reconciliation and found family as what heals a person.
